name: BachPreludeInC
listen_for: Bach's C major prelude on a two-choir harpsichord, each figure ringing on under the next, leaning into the bars where the harmony arrives and slowing into a rolled last chord.

name: PassionChorale
listen_for: Bach's Passion Chorale for trumpet, flugelhorn, horn and trombone in a large church, every phrase slowing into its fermata and taking a breath, the repeat an echo of the first time.

name: FurElise
listen_for: Für Elise on a tine electric piano swaying between the speakers, pedalled bar by bar, broadening into each cadence, pressing on over the drumming bass and slowing down the chromatic scale.

name: HallOfTheMountainKing
listen_for: Grieg's trolls, orchestrated from the piano score: bassoons and pizzicato basses tiptoe through the theme, which climbs, gathers the orchestra and speeds up until the trolls shriek over the timpani.
